omitted_tabs.reason: libpq SSL settings are rows of connection_params on the Engine tab (see gaps).

gaps.concept: SSL/TLS tab fields (ssl_mode, ssl_cert, ssl_key, ssl_ca)
gaps.reason: pgAdmin stores sslmode/sslcert/sslkey/sslrootcert/sslcrl as rows of connection_params, not as separate fields; splitting them out needs a backend change to how connection_params is saved.
pgAdmin uses a 'color' control; the descriptor control set has none, fields are typed text.
control switches between a creatable multi-select and an SQL editor on db_res_type; typed as text.

gaps.concept: rolvaliduntil-style dynamic visibility of profile route/secret fields
gaps.reason: providerConnectionFields()/providerSecretFields() generate cde_route_*/cde_secret_* fields from endpoint profiles at runtime; they belong to the provider_endpoint profiles, not to this form.
readonly/disabled depend on state.connected, isShared and current_user; not expressible as visible_when.

fields.label: ID
fields.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

fields.label: Server group
fields.help: Options are the pgAdmin server groups; hidden when registering through an engine profile.

fields.label: Engine / interface profile
fields.help: Select the native interface used by this endpoint. Engines with multiple interfaces expose each interface as a separate protocol-owned profile. Changing it resets port, connect/verify switches and route defaults (depChange not expressible here).

fields.label: Registration action
fields.help: Hidden field set by the registration workflow (endpoint / create_database / register_existing).

fields.label: Shared Server Owner
fields.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

fields.label: Server type
fields.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

fields.label: Connected?
fields.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

fields.label: Version
fields.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

fields.label: Background
fields.help: Hex colour (pgAdmin 'color' control; no colour control in the descriptor set, see gaps). Disabled while connected.

fields.label: Foreground
fields.help: Hex colour (pgAdmin 'color' control). Disabled while connected.

fields.label: Connect now?
fields.help: Shown for legacy_preserved profiles; provider_endpoint profiles show 'Verify endpoint now?' instead.

fields.label: Verify endpoint now?
fields.help: Shown for provider_endpoint profiles only (visibility depends on the profile workflow, not on a field).

fields.label: Shared?
fields.help: Visible only to admins in pgAdmin server mode; read-only when the server is owned by another user.

fields.label: Shared Username
fields.help: Visible only to admins in server mode; defaults to the username when sharing is switched on.

fields.label: Connection String
fields.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

fields.label: Host name/address
fields.help: Hidden for embedded-file profiles. Either host or service must be given. Changing it on a connected server requires disconnect/reconnect.

fields.label: Port
fields.help: Hidden for embedded-file profiles.

fields.label: Database / file
fields.help: Initial database used to establish the PostgreSQL connection. Use an existing database that this user can access. Read-only while connected or shared.

fields.label: Service
fields.help: pg_service.conf service name; read-only while connected or shared.

fields.label: Username
fields.help: Hidden for embedded-file profiles.

fields.label: Kerberos authentication?
fields.help: When on, the password fields are disabled.

fields.label: GSS authenticated?
fields.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

fields.label: GSS encrypted?
fields.help: Read-only property shown by pgAdmin in properties mode only.

fields.label: Password
fields.help: In edit mode the password field is enabled only if Save Password is set to true. Hidden when the profile declares typed secret fields.

fields.label: Save password?
fields.help: Disabled when the pgAdmin configuration forbids saving passwords or Kerberos is on.

fields.label: Role
fields.help: Read-only while connected.

fields.label: Use SSH tunneling
fields.help: Disabled when the pgAdmin build has no SSH tunnel support; read-only while connected.

fields.label: Prompt for identity file password?
fields.help: Enable to be prompted for the identity file's passphrase at connection time, if the file is passphrase-protected. This setting applies only to identity-file authentication. When using password authentication for the SSH tunnel, leave the SSH password field empty to be prompted on connection.

fields.label: Save password?
fields.help: Disabled when the pgAdmin configuration forbids saving tunnel passwords.

fields.label: DB restriction type
fields.help: Read-only while connected or shared.

fields.label: DB restriction
fields.help: pgAdmin switches the control on db_res_type: a creatable multi-select of database names, or an SQL editor returning names. The descriptor exposes it as text (see gaps).

fields.label: Password exec command
fields.help: The server hostname, port, and username can be passed as variables by using the placeholders %HOSTNAME%, %PORT%, and %USERNAME%, which will be replaced with the corresponding server connection information. Disabled when the server configuration forbids it.

fields.label: Prepare threshold
fields.help: If it is set to 0, every query is prepared the first time it is executed. If it is set to blank, prepared statements are disabled on the connection.

fields.label: Post Connection SQL
fields.help: Any query specified in the control below will be executed with autocommit mode enabled for each connection to any database on this server. Read-only while connected.

fields.label: Connection Parameters
fields.help: libpq keywords (sslmode, connect_timeout, sslcert, ... see options). Defaults: sslmode=prefer, connect_timeout=10. Rows cannot be added or removed while connected. The value cell type follows the keyword's vartype (string/file/enum/integer/bool/password); version-gated keywords show a 'Supported version >= N' placeholder.

columns.label: Keyword
columns.help: Mirrors name; sent to the backend.

fields.label: Tags
fields.help: Maximum count comes from pgAdmin's max_server_tags_allowed; colour is random on add.

notes: Fields map 1:1 onto the legacy pgAdmin dialog (workflow legacy_preserved): field ids are the BaseUISchema ids and are served by the existing SQL templates. Source: web/pgadmin/browser/server_groups/servers/static/js/server.ui.js (ServerSchema, TagsSchema, getConnectionParameters) and static/js/variable.ui.js. pgAdmin groups: General->Connection (no General tab on the server family), Connection->Connection (host/port/db/service) and Authentication (username/password/role/kerberos), SSH Tunnel->Authentication, Advanced + Post Connection SQL->Advanced, Parameters->Engine (libpq keyword grid), Tags->Tags. Not a DDL object: no SQL tab. Field ids are checked against the pgAdmin *.ui.js schema ids by tools/tests/test_ui_descriptor_postgresql_schema_ids.py (the schema id gate); the form stays draft until phase 5 routes it to the SQL templates and ports the ui.spec expectations.
